note: *Deus, meu Deus*, as this Latin psalm has it; the Gospels' cry (Mt 27:46, Mk 15:34 Vulgate) is *Meu Deus, meu Deus*, the option. A Brazilian Catholic will still hear the Passion.

*e não será para a minha insensatez*: the stylist's worst line; verbless, the blind reader heard *para* as *parar*. The copula keeps both readings; Matos Soares 1932's *não por minha culpa* paraphrases and is refused.
*lançaram sortes*, held against two Latinist minors asking the singular: *lançar a sorte* is heard as casting one's fate, while *lançar sortes* is drawing lots, as the blind reader heard it.

D34: *no meio da assembleia*, so 21:23 = Heb 2:12 *in medio ecclesiæ* loses *Igreja*, which Brazilian Catholic ears will miss. *igreja* fails 25:5 *ecclésiam malignántium* and was heard as a building.
*os gordos da terra*: the blind reader heard people with fat bodies first; the image is the Latin's and echoes 21:13 *touros gordos*. *os ricos* (Matos Soares 1932) is the option.
